exposure: Phenylephrine infusion with rescue phenylephrine boluses (as needed)
Prophylactic saline infusion with rescue phenylephrine boluses (as needed)
cohort: 80 patients undergoing elective cesarean section under spinal anesthesia.
finding: Phenylephrine infusion with rescue boluses was significantly more effective in preventing maternal hypotension and providing better blood pressure control during cesarean section under spinal anesthesia compared to rescue boluses alone.
